steps.name: sha-pinned-outgoing-qa-localization-host-and-safe-s22
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C
TARGET=4e70f6a8860c87163164b426e27e62a7eac62709
PKG=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.s8lab
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
git status --short
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git fetch --no-tags origin feat/outgoing-live-qa-20261125
test "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/feat/outgoing-live-qa-20261125)" = "$TARGET"
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
QA_DIR="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-outgoing-qa-s22-XXXXXX)"
BACKUP_DIR="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-outgoing-qa-rollback-XXXXXX)"
SERIAL=""
INSTALLED_NEW=0
BACKED_UP=0
ROLLBACK_OK=0
cleanup() {
  local code="$?"
  trap - EXIT
  if [[ "$code" != 0 && "$INSTALLED_NEW" == 1 && "$BACKED_UP" == 1 ]]; then
    if phone_idle; then
      echo 'QA_FAILED_ATTEMPT_ROLLBACK=true'
      if adb -s "$SERIAL" install --no-streaming -r -d "$BACKUP_DIR/previous.apk" >/dev/null; then
        ROLLBACK_OK=1
        echo 'APP_ROLLBACK_SUCCESS=true'
        if ANDROID_SERIAL="$SERIAL" bash "$QA_DIR/scripts/bin/start-s8-gsm-shell.sh" --start; then
          echo 'PREVIOUS_APP_HOST_RESTORED=true'
        else
          echo 'PREVIOUS_APP_HOST_UNVERIFIED=true'
        fi
      else
        echo 'APP_ROLLBACK_FAILED=true'
      fi
    else
      echo 'ROLLBACK_DEFERRED_NOT_IDLE=true'
    fi
  fi
  cd "$ROOT"
  git worktree remove --force "$QA_DIR" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  if [[ "$code" == 0 || "$ROLLBACK_OK" == 1 || "$INSTALLED_NEW" == 0 ]]; then rm -rf "$BACKUP_DIR"; else echo "BACKUP_RETAINED=$BACKUP_DIR"; fi
  exit "$code"
}
phone_idle() {
  local s m
  s="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9]\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d '\r' || true)"
  m="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*Actual mode = \(MODE_[A-Z_]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d '\r' || true)"
  [[ "$s" == 0 && "$m" == MODE_NORMAL ]]
}
trap cleanup EXIT
git worktree add --detach "$QA_DIR" "$TARGET"
cd "$QA_DIR"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
echo "QA_SHA=$TARGET"
echo 'STAGE=HOST_GATE'
bash scripts/bin/test-profile.sh preflight
bash scripts/bin/test-profile.sh full
echo 'OUTGOING_QA_HOST_PASS=true'
echo 'STAGE=REBUILD_UNCHANGED_SHA'
bash scripts/bin/test-profile.sh device-build
APP=app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
test -s "$APP"
test -s app/build/outputs/apk/androidTest/debug/app-debug-androidTest.apk
echo 'STAGE=VERIFY_EXACT_S22_IDLE'
SERIAL="$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.device.s22_adb_discovery)"
test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state)" = device
test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')" = SM-S906B
test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.release | tr -d '\r')" = 16
phone_idle || { echo 'NOT_IDLE_REFUSED=true'; exit 50; }
# Do not change a production-owned GSM host for a lab test.
HOST_BEFORE="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell content call --uri "content://$PKG.gsmbinder" --method status 2>/dev/null || true)"
[[ "$HOST_BEFORE" == *host_registered=true* ]] || { echo 'LAB_HOST_NOT_PREVIOUSLY_READY_REFUSED=true'; exit 58; }
ROLE="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd role get-role-holders --user 0 android.app.role.DIALER 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' || true)"
[[ "$ROLE" == "$PKG" ]] || { echo 'LAB_NOT_CURRENT_DIALER_REFUSED=true'; exit 59; }
echo 'STAGE=BACKUP_PREVIOUS_TEST_APK'
pkgpaths="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path "$PKG" | tr -d '\r')"
[[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$pkgpaths" | grep -c '^package:')" == 1 ]] || { echo 'AMBIGUOUS_INSTALLED_PACKAGE=true'; exit 51; }
remote="$(printf '%s\n' "$pkgpaths" | sed -n 's/^package://p')"
adb -s "$SERIAL" pull "$remote" "$BACKUP_DIR/previous.apk" >/dev/null
test -s "$BACKUP_DIR/previous.apk"
BACKED_UP=1
phone_idle || { echo 'CALL_STATE_CHANGED_BEFORE_INSTALL=true'; exit 52; }
echo 'STAGE=INSTALL_TEST_APK'
adb -s "$SERIAL" install --no-streaming -r "$APP"
INSTALLED_NEW=1
phone_idle || { echo 'CALL_STATE_CHANGED_AFTER_INSTALL=true'; exit 53; }
echo 'STAGE=RESTORE_GSM_BINDER_HOST'
export ANDROID_SERIAL="$SERIAL"
bash scripts/bin/start-s8-gsm-shell.sh --start
hoststatus="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell content call --uri "content://$PKG.gsmbinder" --method status 2>/dev/null || true)"
[[ "$hoststatus" == *host_registered=true* ]] || { echo 'HOST_NOT_READY_AFTER_BOOTSTRAP=true'; exit 54; }
echo 'S8_GSM_BINDER_HOST_READY=true'
echo 'STAGE=APK_HASH_VERIFICATION'
pkgpaths="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path "$PKG" | tr -d '\r')"
[[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$pkgpaths" | grep -c '^package:')" == 1 ]] || exit 55
remote="$(printf '%s\n' "$pkgpaths" | sed -n 's/^package://p')"
adb -s "$SERIAL" pull "$remote" "$BACKUP_DIR/installed.apk" >/dev/null
test "$(shasum -a 256 "$APP" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(shasum -a 256 "$BACKUP_DIR/installed.apk" | awk '{print $1}')"
echo 'INSTALLED_APK_SHA256_MATCH=true'
echo 'STAGE=PHYSICAL_UI_SAFE_SUITE'
bash scripts/bin/run-s22-safe-ui-lab.sh --approved-idle
phone_idle || { echo 'POSTFLIGHT_NOT_IDLE=true'; exit 56; }
hoststatus="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell content call --uri "content://$PKG.gsmbinder" --method status 2>/dev/null || true)"
[[ "$hoststatus" == *host_registered=true* ]] || { echo 'POSTFLIGHT_HOST_MISSING=true'; exit 57; }
INSTALLED_NEW=0
echo 'AICALLS_OUTGOING_S22_SAFE_QA_PASS=true'
echo "QA_SHA=$TARGET"
echo "LAB_PACKAGE=$PKG"
echo 'NO_GSM_CALLS=true USER_DATA_PRESERVED=true'
